@PattyArquette I've never had a prayer answered by a God. I understand why people do it, and I do not condemn that freedom. Anything that I have ever prayed for was answered with the polar opposite of what was needed so I'm done praying. 
But I'm ready to give my life for #BlackLivesMatter .

@RoArquette No one should ever put their knee on someone's neck. That is a killing move against a man who was not a threat. #GeorgeFloyd was murdered in front of the World. #TheWorldIsWatching #BlackLivesMatter
